These queries are untested, since nothing can be run here. They are written from the documentation page alone, so a few steps are guesses:

- Plain `sort` with no key modifier on strings.
- `sum` of an empty vector answering 0.
- `split ""` and a trailing empty field in `split ","` behaving as I assume.

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer * (* (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
R7: trim | lines * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
R8: trim | lines * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: trim | lines | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~/1 * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: trim | lines | drop 1 * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(ne "") * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * [(split "=" | /0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=" | trim)] | tag ::map
R12: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | entries * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~/name
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "Elder" "cherry" "fig" "Apple"] * lower | groupBy * count | filter ~(gt 1) | keys * keyword | sort
